items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: You know who played the bass — speaking about Bob Haggart, Milt Hinton, Michael Moore — you know who played the bass for the soundtrack of “The Benny Goodman Story?”

ctx.x: You know who played the bass — speaking about Bob Haggart, Milt Hinton, Michael Moore — you know who played the bass for the soundtrack of “The Benny Goodman Story?” Very few people know.
